about: Hard matcher eval: typed requests labelled with the catalog case ids that cover them (grounded by reading each case). relation same = the ids in match cover it; partial = they cover only part; new = nothing covers it. near = related but not the same.

rows.typed: remove a supplier from the invite list before they've quoted anything - should work and they lose access
rows.why: Buyer removes a not-yet-bid vendor; succeeds and vendor can no longer see the event.

rows.typed: allocating 60 + 60 units on a 100 qty line item should be blocked
rows.why: Total award across vendors above the line quantity is refused. XAWD-107/XMAT-007 are the partial-off config gap (near).

rows.typed: converting the same RFQ into an auction a second time should be rejected
rows.why: Second conversion of an already-converted RFQ is refused (code 94).

rows.typed: cloning a project that is still in draft isn't permitted
rows.why: Clone of a draft event is refused.

rows.typed: exchange rate should get locked once the first bid comes in
rows.why: Changing currency rates after a bid is refused.

rows.typed: publishing a project where the technical round closes after the RFQ closes should fail
rows.why: Publish with RFP end after RFQ end refused (712). XSTG-021 is at live round creation; XMAT-037/XPUB-064 are extensions.

rows.typed: once the approver approves the award proposal, the award should become final
rows.why: Final approval makes the award selected. KBSRC-633/639 only record one approval (near).

rows.typed: supplier quoting a bigger quantity than the buyer asked for on a line should get an error
rows.why: Vendor over-quantity offer refused (138) when over-quantity is off.

rows.typed: vendor quotes in a different unit of measure than the line item
rows.why: Bid in a unit other than the requested one is refused.

rows.typed: if there is a price cap on the line, a quote above it gets bounced
rows.why: Vendor price above the ceiling/price cap refused (38). Floor-price variants near.

rows.typed: when publish approval is configured, the stage should sit in requested status instead of going live
rows.why: Approval-gated publish leaves the stage 'requested' with a pending approval.

rows.typed: supplier revises his quote while bidding is still open and the new number replaces the old one
rows.why: Revision inside the window succeeds and becomes the current bid (old kept in history).

rows.typed: technical questionnaire submitted with a required question left empty gets rejected
rows.why: Vendor technical response with a blank mandatory answer refused.

rows.typed: sending a counter offer on a bid that's already been awarded is refused
rows.why: Counter offer on a selected (awarded) bid refused (101). XDNEG-012 is a bid under award approval.

rows.typed: rejecting a participant with an empty remark is not accepted
rows.why: Reject participant requires remarks (752).

rows.typed: an RFQ stage and an auction stage can't both be added to the same project
rows.why: Create screen refuses RFQ+Auction together. XSTG-003 documents the API does not block it (near).

rows.typed: only the owner can hand over ownership of an event, another buyer trying it gets refused
rows.why: Change-ownership by a non-owner buyer is refused.

rows.typed: vendor revises after being put on the award proposal, then submitting the proposal is blocked
rows.why: Proposal submit refused when an awarded bid was revised (1126/683).

rows.typed: technical score higher than the top of the rating scale should be rejected
rows.why: Score one above the highest label refused (code 2). Section-wise max (XAWD-026) near.

rows.typed: supplier who skipped the technical round must answer it first before he can put prices in the RFQ
rows.why: Commercial bid without a technical response refused (737).

rows.typed: trying to award a vendor who never placed a bid should fail
rows.why: Award response for a non-bidder refused (826).

rows.typed: try re-activating an event that was withdrawn earlier, expect a refusal
rows.why: Re-publishing/activating a withdrawn event is refused or has no effect. XPUB-007 is the status=draft resurrection route (near).

rows.typed: putting one item into lot 1 and lot 2 at the same time should throw an error
rows.why: Duplicate item across lots refused (XDLOT-041 expects 422 on create_new_lot, today accepted).

rows.typed: push the closing time of a running RFQ by half an hour and make sure suppliers see the new time
rows.why: Extending a live window; new end visible to buyer and vendor, bidding continues.

rows.typed: supplier clicking I don't wish to participate without picking any reason should be stopped
rows.why: Decline intent without reason refused (code 2).

rows.typed: deadline khatam hone ke baad vendor apna quote revise na kar paye
rows.why: Vendor who already bid revises after bid end: XBID-085 (revise endpoint) and XMAT-030 (in extra closing time, earlier bidder cannot change price). EVDTME-068 needs the end pulled in.

rows.typed: negative quantity daalne par line item reject hona chahiye
rows.why: Buyer creates/saves a line item with negative quantity: refused. PR-route, live-edit, buyer-column and vendor-quantity variants are near.

rows.typed: 500 vendors invite karo publish ho jaye, 501 pe error aana chahiye
rows.why: Audience cap: 501 refused (511). XPUB-032 checks only the 500 side; XPUB-044 is live add-audience.

rows.typed: GST negative daala to bid reject hona chahiye
rows.why: Vendor negative GST refused (107).

rows.typed: open tender pe vendor khud se participate kar sake
rows.why: Vendor self-participation on an active open tender succeeds; refusal variants near.

rows.typed: same vendor ko do alag bids submit nahi karne dena
rows.why: A vendor company with an active bid cannot create/submit a second one (teammate included). Concurrency and subsidiary variants near.

rows.typed: buyer vendor ki taraf se RFQ me bid daal sake
rows.why: Buyer places a surrogate RFQ bid for an invited vendor; succeeds.

rows.typed: RFQ ko auction mein convert karo, purane vendors turant auction me bid kar paye
rows.why: After conversion, carried-over vendor's auction bid is accepted.

rows.typed: ek hi product do baar add kiya to duplicate line item silently nahi banna chahiye
rows.why: Same product twice at create: merged/refused/explicitly two lines, never a crash or silent duplicate.

rows.typed: withdraw kiye hue event pe vendor bid na kar paye
rows.why: Vendor bid on a withdrawn event refused (UI-PUB-017 checks it after withdrawing).

rows.typed: live event ko clone karo, naya draft banna chahiye same line items ke saath
rows.why: Cloning an active event returns a new draft copying line items/config.

rows.typed: rank based auction me vendor ko apna rank dikhna chahiye, price nahi
rows.why: Rank auction vendor sees own rank (not prices). Pure leak checks near.

rows.typed: BOQ me 501 line items daalo to error aana chahiye
rows.why: BOQ above the 500-line default is refused at create/publish.

rows.typed: knockout auction ka starting price RFQ ke L1 se zyada ho to error aana chahiye
rows.why: Converting to knockout with a start above the RFQ L1 sum total is refused (966).

rows.typed: auction ke last 5 minute me vendor apna price badha na paye
rows.why: Single-line round within 5 min of end: price increase refused (300).

rows.typed: vendro cant submitt bid aftr deadlne
rows.why: Same as the owner's row: vendor's bid after the window closes is refused.

rows.typed: evalutor scoring befor techincal round close
rows.why: Evaluator scores while the technical round is still open: refused. XAWD-030 is submitting (not scoring) before close.

rows.typed: ammendment publish without remraks shuld be refusd
rows.why: Publishing an amendment with blank/absent remarks must be refused (XPUB-107/108, XDAMD-022 expect 422 despite today's 500/200). Whitespace and string-remark variants near.

rows.typed: tick size negativ in auction
rows.why: Creating an auction round with a negative tick size should be refused.

rows.typed: surogate bid for vendor who alredy bid himself
rows.why: Buyer's surrogate bid for a vendor with its own active bid is refused by default. XMAT-012 is a second surrogate bid (near).

rows.typed: vendr opening bid on drft stage shud fail
rows.why: Vendor opens a bid on an unpublished stage: refused (33).

rows.typed: knockout step intrval less thn 30 sec
rows.why: Knockout time difference under 30 s refused (248), at creation and at conversion.

rows.typed: trafic light lower bound abov upper bound refusd
rows.why: Inverted traffic-light range refused. Equal bounds (XSTG-039, XDAUC-039) is a different condition.

rows.typed: publsh evnt without any particpants shuld be blockd
rows.why: Publish with no participants refused (XPUB-028 expects 422; today 200).

rows.typed: awrd more qty then vendor offerd
rows.why: Awarding a vendor more than it quoted is refused. Line-quantity over-award is near.

rows.typed: vendr uplod attachmnt with bid, buyer shud be able to open it
rows.why: Bid attachment submitted by vendor is visible/downloadable to buyer.

rows.typed: evalutor sends score as text insted of number
rows.why: Score sent as a string is refused (code 2).

rows.typed: late bid
rows.why: Read as a vendor bid after the deadline (refused); auction last-minute bids that extend the clock are a different behaviour (near).

rows.typed: negative price bid
rows.why: Vendor enters a negative price, refused. Surrogate, buyer-column, BOQ-upload and counter-price variants are near.

rows.typed: discount more than 100% in the bid
rows.why: Vendor discount above 100% refused. EVI-CHG-008 allows either refusal or a non-negative total (near).

rows.typed: schedule with end time earlier than the start time
rows.why: Setting/creating a round whose end is before its start is refused. Reschedule (EVDTME-018) and auction conversion are near.

rows.typed: tie at L1
rows.why: Two vendors at the same lowest RFQ price both shown as best/L1. Auction ties and L1 award accounting are near.

rows.typed: zero price
rows.why: Vendor quotes 0: refused / not counted as a quote. Zero counter price and zero exchange rate are near.

rows.typed: clone PR event
rows.why: Cloning a PR-created event is refused. XDLST-074 is the withdrawn-PR exception.

rows.typed: withdraw twice
rows.why: Withdrawing an already-withdrawn event is a no-op (no duplicate remark/notification).

rows.typed: double click publish
rows.why: Two near-simultaneous publishes create one event/one write. Re-publishing a live event later is near.

rows.typed: xss in event title
rows.why: Script/HTML in the event title stored/rendered inert.

rows.typed: same vendor twice in audience
rows.why: Listing one vendor twice yields one audience row.

rows.typed: zero quantity line item
rows.why: Buyer line item with 0 quantity refused on a normal event; BOQ/PR rate-only lines are near.

rows.typed: buyer rejects a vendor's quote and unticks allow re-bid, then the vendor tries to bid again - he should be blocked
rows.why: Both parts (reject without re-bid, then vendor's bid refused) are covered end to end by EVDRJB-003 and KBSRC-048.

rows.typed: create an RFQ, invite a vendor, vendor bids, then buyer awards - the award should be created
rows.why: AWD-021 runs the whole chain (draft, stage, activate, bid, proposal, approval, submit) ending awarded.

rows.typed: publish RFP+RFQ, vendor answers the technical questionnaire, evaluator scores it, then vendor quotes in the RFQ
rows.why: Publish (KBSRC-011), vendor response (UI-VBID-028) and evaluator scoring (UI-TECH-018/API-TECH-011) are covered separately; no case chains scoring into the later RFQ quote.

rows.typed: vendor bids 100, buyer sends counter offer at 90, vendor accepts it - his bid should now be 90
rows.why: Accepted counter offer revises the vendor's bid to the counter price.

rows.typed: RFQ closes with quotes, convert it to an auction keeping RFQ quotes as starting bids, then vendors bid lower in the auction
rows.why: Conversion with RFQ quotes as starting bids (KBSRC-078) and bidding in the converted auction (UI-CONV-013, XMAT-052) are separate; no case checks a lower bid against the carried quote.

rows.typed: create an RFQ with end time already in the past, publish it, then the vendor tries to bid
rows.why: UI-SCH-006 covers publish with a past end and the vendor's bid being refused.

rows.typed: two vendors quote 100 and 90 on an RFQ, buyer opens the comparison and 90 should be marked L1
rows.why: Lowest price shown as best/L1 in the buyer's comparison. BID-036 is a rank auction (near).

rows.typed: submit the award proposal, approver rejects it, then the buyer should be able to award again
rows.why: Rejected proposal returns the event to awardable (new draft with same allocation).

rows.typed: set the RFQ end time to 90 seconds from now, wait for it to pass, then the vendor tries to place a bid
rows.why: End pulled in, then vendor's bid refused (33).

rows.typed: close an RFQ where one vendor bid, extend the submission time, then the other vendor bids and the first one revises
rows.why: XMAT-032: extension of a closed round reopens bidding; new bid and revision both accepted.

rows.typed: buyer must not be able to kick out a vendor who has already submitted a quote
rows.why: Removing a vendor with a submitted bid is refused. XPUB-046 is the technical-response variant.

rows.typed: withdrawing a live event without giving a reason should not go through
rows.why: Withdraw with blank/absent remark must be refused (XPUB-077 expects 422, today 500).

rows.typed: buyer should not be able to place a normal bid on his own event as his own company
rows.why: Buying company bidding on its own event is refused; XBID-031 is the technical-stage variant.

rows.typed: vendor should NOT be able to see other vendors' prices
rows.why: Every case whose purpose is that a vendor cannot read a competitor's price/quote (screens, quote-by-id, L1 endpoints, downloads, rank auction). Award-visibility and remarks are near.

rows.typed: the evaluator must not be able to see commercial prices
rows.why: Evaluator sees technical answers but never RFQ prices. EVDQRY-048 is the query-assignment leak path (near).

rows.typed: buyer should not be able to revoke a counter offer that the vendor has already accepted
rows.why: Revoke after acceptance refused (code 4).

rows.typed: a vendor should never be able to convert the RFQ into an auction
rows.why: Vendor calling move_to_auction refused (455).

rows.typed: buyer of some other company must not be able to open my event
rows.why: Cross-tenant buyer cannot read the event (direct, raw id, card refresh). Same-company other buyer (XPUB-084) and per-feature reads are near.

rows.typed: evaluator shouldn't be able to submit evaluation when one responding vendor is still unscored
rows.why: Submit with an unscored responder refused (571).

rows.typed: it must not be possible to delete the last remaining line item of an event
rows.why: Removing the only/last active line item is refused (711); XDBOQ-029 is the duplicate-row bypass that should also be refused.

rows.typed: a submitted award proposal must not be discardable like a draft
rows.why: Discarding a submitted (requested) proposal refused (888).

rows.typed: buyer must not be able to extend the closing time once an award proposal is created
rows.why: Extension after a proposal exists refused (801).

rows.typed: vendor should not be allowed to extend the deadline
rows.why: Vendor PATCH increase_auction_time refused (455). EVDTME-012 is reschedule/re-time via vendor app (near).

rows.typed: supplier who is not invited should not be able to place a quote
rows.why: Uninvited vendor's bid refused. Visibility-only and surrogate-for-uninvited cases are near.

rows.typed: create an rfq event check whether a vendor can bid after submission time is over
rows.why: Vendor (not buyer-on-behalf) opens/prices/submits on an RFQ after bid end (incl. extra closing time) and is refused; XMAT-017 is the surrogate variant, EVDTME-066..068 need the end pulled in first.

rows.typed: can a supplier still put a price in the RFQ for an item he regretted in the technical stage?
rows.why: Pricing a technically regretted line in the commercial round (refused). EVDRGT-011 is the one-round case (near).

rows.typed: is it possible to unlock sealed bids while the RFQ is still live?
rows.why: Unlocking locked bids before the bid end.

rows.typed: can the buyer extend an RFQ after it has already closed?
rows.why: Extending the end of an expired/closed RFQ: refused without reopen rights or once closed (XPUB-061/062, XMAT-033), accepted where reopening is allowed (XMAT-032). Reschedule/reopen-lines near.

rows.typed: if a vendor declined the invitation, can he still go ahead and bid?
rows.why: Bid after a decline (expected refused; today accepted).

rows.typed: does every invited vendor actually get the invitation when I publish?
rows.why: Publish sends one invitation to each invited vendor.

rows.typed: can I add more vendors to a stage whose bidding has already ended?
rows.why: add_audience on a closed/ended stage (expected refused).

rows.typed: is the buyer allowed to enter a surrogate bid before the RFQ has started?
rows.why: Surrogate bid on an Upcoming stage (accepted when surrogate is allowed). Vendor's own early bid is near.

rows.typed: can a vendor see his own rank on a normal RFQ?
rows.why: RFQ vendor view carries no rank. Rank auctions near.

rows.typed: does creating or publishing an RFQ with zero line items fail?
rows.why: Non-BOQ create/save/stage without line items refused. BOQ empty-create is the allowed exception (near).

rows.typed: can the weight parameters still be changed after a vendor has submitted a bid?
rows.why: Weights after bids: locked unless allow_edit_weight_param_rfq (EVDWGT-060/061/066, screen UI-EVDWGT-002). Auction flag variant near.

rows.typed: is the line total calculated as price x quantity plus the GST on that line?
rows.why: Line total = price*qty*(1+GST/100).

rows.typed: with auto-award switched on, the L1 vendor should get awarded automatically when the RFQ closes
rows.why: Only XSTG-116 touches auto_award_configs (type validation); no case checks an automatic award at close.

rows.typed: buyer pauses a live reverse auction for 10 minutes and resumes it, the timer should freeze while paused
rows.why: Searched pause/resume/freeze/suspend/on hold: catalog has extend, shorten and force-end only; no pause.

rows.typed: an RFQ should not be awardable unless at least three vendors have quoted
rows.why: No minimum-bidder gate on award; XDAPR-060 only routes a single-bidder award to extra approval.

rows.typed: vendor has to enter a quote validity date and it cannot be earlier than the RFQ closing date
rows.why: No 'validity / valid till' field is tested anywhere; XTPL-017 is a generic impossible-date column check.

rows.typed: auction dynamic extension should stop after a maximum of 5 extensions
rows.why: Opposite-polarity trap: XDAUC-076 asserts there is NO cap (6 extensions all applied); nothing expects a cap.

rows.typed: publishing a second event with exactly the same title as a live event should warn the buyer
rows.why: Duplicate-title search found nothing; VAL-015 is about duplicate create requests, not title clashes.

rows.typed: vendors who were not awarded should get a not-awarded email once the award is approved
rows.why: No award/regret notification to losing vendors is tested; EVDLEK-005 only checks what a losing vendor can see.

rows.typed: after the RFQ closes every vendor should be able to see all the competitors' quotes
rows.why: Opposite-polarity trap: isolation cases expect vendors never see competitors (incl. after award); none expects disclosure after close.

rows.typed: the evaluator should be allowed to start scoring while the technical round is still open
rows.why: Opposite-polarity trap: XMAT-061/XAWD-018 expect scoring before close to be refused; no case expects it allowed.

rows.typed: buyer should be able to switch a live auction from rank based to price based
rows.why: Opposite-polarity trap: KBSRC-305 expects the strategy to be locked once live; EVDAUX-009 is the sealed-bid switch, not the strategy.

rows.typed: buyer should be able to edit the awarded quantities after submitting the award for approval
rows.why: Opposite-polarity trap: EVDNFA-003/XDAPR-061 expect the submitted award to be locked; editing requires withdraw (XDAPR-091).

rows.typed: a vendor's saved draft should be auto-submitted as his final bid when the deadline hits
rows.why: No auto-submit behaviour exists or is tested; EVDTME-067 notes the end-of-bidding job discards drafts (opposite).

rows.typed: when the buyer extends an RFQ deadline every invited vendor must get an email with the new closing time
rows.why: Opposite-polarity trap: EVDTME-035 asserts RFQ extensions send NO 'Submission time extended' mail (only auctions do); nothing expects an RFQ email.

rows.typed: RFQ should close automatically as soon as all invited vendors have submitted their bids
rows.why: Searched auto-close/early close: no case closes a round on full participation.

rows.typed: buyer uploads an excel of vendor emails and all of them get added as participants of the RFQ
rows.why: Bulk upload exists only for the vendor master (KBVON-043/XVBU); audience is added by search or quick invite, never by file.

rows.typed: limit each vendor to at most 3 revisions of his quote in an RFQ
rows.why: No revision-count limit is tested; XBID-086 is a full lock after submission, KBSRC-322 a minimum-revisions display rule.

rows.typed: a line item delivery date earlier than the bid end time should be refused when publishing
rows.why: Only the Reschedule dialog compares start with the delivery date (UI-EVDTME-002); nothing checks delivery date vs bid end at publish.

rows.typed: buyer attaches a drawing to a line item and the invited vendor can download it from his bid sheet
rows.why: Line-item attachments only appear in EVDDOC-048 (company-folder check); no case checks vendor-side download.

rows.typed: if a vendor gets blacklisted after bidding, his bid should drop out of the comparison and he cannot be awarded
rows.why: Blacklist cases cover audience drop at publish, counter-offer button and queries; none covers a bid already in.

rows.typed: the RFQ should let the buyer set a hidden reserve price and flag every bid above it in the comparison
rows.why: Searched reserve/hidden/target price: only knockout target price and the refusing price cap exist; no hidden reserve flagging.
